title: The check-ride
summary: The whole of Flight 312, Philadelphia to Kennedy: the clearance, the takeoff, the airways, the ILS and the landing.
briefing: This is your check-ride: Flight 312 to Kennedy, all of it. The clearance, the takeoff, the climb, the cruise, the ILS and the landing.
You work the radio this time, and I only watch. Fly it the way you've been taught, and I'll sign your book at the gate.

tasks.goal: Fly Flight 312 to Kennedy and land.
tasks.say: Whenever you're ready, Captain. Tune clearance delivery: they'll call us first.

debrief.three: A flight I'd put my family on. Congratulations, Captain: you've passed with distinction.
debrief.two: A good, safe flight. You've passed. Polish the approach and the landing will follow.
debrief.one: You've passed: safely there, if not prettily. Fly the approach practice, then come back.
debrief.failed: Not this time. Every check pilot has seen a bad day: come back and fly it again.
